Question: Assalamualaykum w w I would like to know when female are in their period, i would like to know if i could touch her for example from the chest to the bottom i know icannot do anything can you hug her and go to sleep.please let me know. Answer ID: 9377 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2430/1924=H/1429) While the wife is in her menses, it is forbidden to have intercourse; it is highly undesirable to have pleasure from the parts between navel and knees without a cover, while it is allowed to sleep, hug etc without any desirability. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
